summary: TODO-006 satisfies the approved re-join requirements. The implementation adds the rejoin API, UI mode, DB lookup, and DB-level normalized-name uniqueness with sufficient static, API, concurrency, production-guard, and browser evidence. No blockers found.
evidence: `src/app/api/rejoin/route.ts:8-26` calls `configGuard()` first, validates required fields, maps failed lookup to the generic not-found error, handles ambiguous matches, and sets `cp_pid` only on success.

`supabase/migrations/20260927170000_participant_rejoin.sql:3-18` defines `normalize_name()` and a partial unique index on `(team_id, normalize_name(name))`, enforcing unambiguous team-member names at the DB level.

`supabase/migrations/20260927170000_participant_rejoin.sql:20-60` updates `join_team` so duplicate normalized names in a team return the required Korean '다시 들어가기' guidance while preserving existing join checks.

`supabase/migrations/20260927170000_participant_rejoin.sql:62-87` implements `rejoin_lookup` by session code, team join code, and normalized participant name, returning not_found/ambiguous/found without checking session status.
`src/lib/db.ts:398-408` exposes `findRejoinParticipant()` through the Supabase RPC, keeping name matching inside the DB function.
`src/components/join-form.tsx:17-46` and `:50-110` add the 새로 참가/다시 들어가기 modes, POST `/api/rejoin` in rejoin mode, preserve initial session code, and route success to `/race`.
Static evidence inspected at `runtime/static/TODO-006/summary.txt`: `VALIDATE_STATUS=PASSED`, lint baseline matched, TypeScript exit 0.

Browser evidence inspected at `runtime/web/TODO-006/report.md`: `BROWSER_STATUS=PASSED`, covering rejoin via `/` and `/join/[code]`, duplicate-name refusal, pending SUN submission exactly once, and participant row counts.

API/DB evidence inspected in `evidence/TODO-006/api-check-006.local.out.txt`, `db-checks.local.txt`, and `prod-rejoin-006.local.out.txt`: AC1-AC6, normalized matching, generic errors, concurrent duplicate joins, DB grants, and production 503 guard all passed.
